mapper.insert: INSERT INTO academies (name, address, phone, business_cer, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name},#{address},#{phone},#{business_cer},NOW(),NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT academy_id, name, address, phone, business_cer, created_at, updated_at FROM academies ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT academy_id, name, address, phone, business_cer, created_at, updated_at FROM academies WHERE academy_id = #{academy_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE academies SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, business_cer = #{business_cer}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE academy_id = #{academy_id}
